SATOM 4.11.1

A fix release. On an HA cluster, Verify SSL certificate now applies to every member and Test Connection tests each member; an update no longer rolls back because the scheduler took more than 60 s to restart.

👤 ForViewerOperatorAdministratorAdvanced user
On this page
  • In short
  • Fixed
  • Before you update
  • Upgrading

Released: 2026-11-06 · All releases

In short#

A fix release with two corrections reported from a customer test install. Everything in 4.11.0 and earlier applies.

Fixed#

  • HA cluster: Verify SSL certificate now applies to the members (SA-0012). On a per-node cluster, ticking the box on the cluster's page did not make SATOM check the members' certificates against the trust store. Each member kept the setting it got when it was created, so the cluster said "Yes" while its members kept connecting unverified. A member now always uses its cluster's setting. Its Edit page shows the box greyed out with a link to the cluster, and detaching a member keeps the setting it was running with. Turning verification off on a cluster needs the password every member stores. Test Connection on a per-node cluster tests every member and names the one that fails. See HA clusters and failover.
  • An update is no longer rolled back because the scheduler restart took more than 60 s (SA-0013). When it is stopped, the scheduler first finishes the scheduled actions it is running. With slow devices that took longer than the 60 s the update runner allowed, and the update rolled back. The runner now waits as long as systemd itself may take.

Before you update#

The update is applied by the runner already installed on the node, so a node on 4.11.0 or older still allows the scheduler only 60 s when it installs this release. If an update rolled back with … 'restart', 'satom-scheduler.service'] timed out after 60 seconds, stop the scheduler first, then apply:

sudo satom execute stop scheduler
sudo satom execute update package satom-update-4.11.1.tar.gz --yes

See Offline updates.

Upgrading#

No database migration. Apply satom-update-4.11.1.tar.gz (Software Update page, or the command above), or pull v4.11.1 on a git-driven node. On an HA pair update the standby first.

#release#4.11.1#what's new#changelog#ha cluster#verify ssl#trust store#test connection#software update#rollback#scheduler
